hooks.command: sh -c 'ANTHROPIC_MODEL=claude-sonnet-5; export ANTHROPIC_MODEL; if [ -x node_modules/.bin/probity ]; then node_modules/.bin/probity --agent claude-code; else npx --yes @nizos/probity@1.10.0 --agent claude-code; fi'

hooks.rewakeMessage: RoboRev flagged the last commit (FAIL) - ADVISORY under the PR-boundary cadence: read the finding now; fix now only if a later commit would compound it, otherwise carry it to the PR boundary. Respond+close happens AT THE PR BOUNDARY, where the branch review (roborev review --branch --base <integration>) is the sole source of actionable findings and every open job gets an explicit disposition - never silently skipped. Round cap: 3 fix rounds TOTAL in the merge range (the merge gate counts every review-fix commit; the escalation ruling records chain judgment), then judgment exit: decline with recorded reasoning surfaced to the human, or record an escalation ruling (git config branch.<branch>.cbrEscalation).
